and all-weather capability, this part-time,
shift-on-the-fly system divides torque 50/50
between front and rear axles for tough traction.

from 2WD to 4WD at speeds up to 45 mph.
For serious rock-crawling, its 2.72:1 low
range ensures confidence. Standard on
Sport and Sahara.®
SELEC-TRAC® FULL-TIME 4x4 SYSTEM
This proven Jeep Brand 4WD system, with
®
its active 4WD transfer case, does all the
thinking so you can concentrate on the
scenery. Selec-Trac analyzes the situation
for you and sends torque to the wheels with
the most grip. The system provides continuous,
optimum traction that effortlessly conquers
snow, ice, rocks, mud — and everything in
between. The system’s Smart Lock maintains
constant 4WD action when you take to the
trail or face challenging road conditions.

with this extreme 4WD system. Its 4:1 low-gear
ratio allows Wrangler Rubicon to crawl at a
low speed for greater control and increases
the amount of torque available at the wheels.
